record.label: Compact-strip regularity and approximation
record.statement: In pure zero-field SK with xi(t)=t^2/2, for every gamma in U (nonnegative, nondecreasing, right-continuous and L1 on [0,1)), the control value Phi with terminal |x| is even, convex, one-Lipschitz, and |x|<=Phi(t,x)<=|x|+sqrt(2(1-t)/pi)+(1/2)int_t^1 gamma. Every positive spatial derivative is bounded and jointly continuous on [0,T]xR for T<1, locally absolutely continuous in time and satisfies the differentiated PDE almost everywhere. L1 coefficient approximation, including finite-step coefficients with terminal M_n^(-1)log(2cosh(M_n x)), M_n->infinity, gives uniform derivative convergence on each such strip.
